The structure is described in a hexagonal setting with lattice parameters a = 5.14801408 Å, b = 5.14801408 Å, c = 9.870193 Å, α = 90°, β = 90°, and γ = 120.00000108°. The input cell contains 18 atoms with composition Li₂Ca₂Ni₂F₁₂. The symmetry is that of space group number 163, P-31c, with Hall symbol -P 3 2c.

Fractional coordinates are used throughout. The standard and input frames are related by q_standard = P q_input + s, where the transformation matrix P is essentially the identity matrix with negligible numerical noise on the order of 10⁻¹⁸ to 10⁻³⁴ in the off-diagonal elements, and the origin shift s is (3.33333333379926 × 10⁻⁷, 0.9999996666666666, 0.0), which corresponds to a shift of approximately (0, 1, 0) modulo unit translations with a tiny x-component perturbation. The input coordinates were rounded to six decimal places before the precision corrections listed below were applied.

The independent atomic orbits are as follows. Lithium occupies Wyckoff site 2c with multiplicity 2, represented by the fractional coordinates (1/3, 2/3, 1/4). Calcium occupies Wyckoff site 2b with multiplicity 2, represented by (0, 0, 0). Nickel occupies Wyckoff site 2d with multiplicity 2, represented by (2/3, 1/3, 1/4). Fluorine occupies the general Wyckoff site 12i with multiplicity 12, represented by the independent parameters x = 0.0189056666666666, y = 0.36676833333333336, z = 0.640317, giving the representative position (0.0189056666666666, 0.36676833333333336, 0.640317).
